scope: Replacement Pi student: selection, Pi parity/timing, live lit-room checks; no balloons in view, no flight qualification
criterion:
Pi student selection criterion, fixed 2026-10-10 before ranking per-model results.
Eligible: the 26 photometric-trained students (photo-42/43 and all 24 clutter-arm runs).
Score: plain `mser` search, sweep scope (8 shifts), summed over development panels 2 and 3,
both colors: (red TP + blue TP) - (red FP + blue FP). Highest score wins; ties go to the
lower unshifted FP on both panels combined.
Gate: the winner must beat new-views-42 on the same score on each panel separately.
